name: fanout-hub
description: Single-read fan-out of one non-replayable async byte stream to multiple subscribers, with bounded in-memory cache and tempdir spill. Python standard library only.

modules.fanout: Hub dispatcher and claim-once Stream async iterators
modules.fanout.testing: ControlledSource controllable async byte source and chunk helpers
modules.fanout.selftest: verification suite including disk-vs-source byte comparison

registered.name: verify
registered.description: Runs the 13-case verification suite: chunk fidelity with preserved boundaries and empty chunks; single shared source read; on-demand fast/slow progress; disk-spill byte-for-byte comparison against the source payload; memory watermark bound (memory_bytes + one current source chunk); entitlement release on stream close; source closed and awaited on last close; source error propagated with original type and message after each stream's entitled prefix; cancelling a pending next closes the stream; concurrent next on one stream rejected; closed stream ends immediately; ValueError contract for index/claim/argument violations; repeatable resource release; tempdir hygiene with pre-existing files untouched.

registered.name: demo:fast-slow
registered.description: Fast/slow dual-stream demo: one fast and one slow subscriber share a single read of a paced source (10 x 48B chunks, 128B memory budget). The fast stream finishes at ~0.6s while the slow one paces at 0.25s/chunk; retained chunks spill to the tempdir (peak 5 files, cache pinned at 96B) and are reclaimed as the slow stream catches up. Verifies identical output on both streams, a single source read, and full temp-file cleanup with the pre-existing file kept.
